title: 'AI trade never died': Traders see room for market recovery, but bitcoin's participation is another story
content: Monday's tech enthusiasm is quickly fading on Tuesday, while bitcoin remains near bear-market lows.

title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
content: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
content: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

title: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked as $2 million in memecoins were sold
content: Ansem suspects someone broke into his account on Bullpen, the trading terminal he co-founded, where the wallet's private key had been imported.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
content: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.

title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
content: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
content: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
content: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
content: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
content: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

title: What Is Pons? The Robinhood Chain Meme Coin Launchpad Explained
content: Pons lets anyone launch a fixed-supply token on Robinhood Chain in one transaction. Here's how it works, and what its PONS token does.

title: Ansem Meme Coin Crashes After $2.57 Million Wallet Drain, Bullpen Confirms Security Breach
content: Bullpen identified unauthorized transfers from as many as 19 early accounts after millions moved from wallets linked to Ansem.

title: Europol Traces $28M in Crypto Behind Europe's Illegal Streaming Industry
content: Police from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to follow crypto payments made to pirate TV services.

title: Justice Department Moves to Forfeit $1.1B in USDC From North Korea's Binance Hack
content: U.S. authorities say they've now helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9 billion of the crypto stolen from Binance in October.

title: CertiK Trains Interpol Investigators to Trace and Freeze Stolen Crypto
content: The blockchain security firm walked officers from across Asia and the South Pacific through a real wallet-theft case at a workshop in Hanoi.

title: Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts
content: Bitcoin Magazine Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts Coinkite published its full Coldcard postmortem, saying a five-year firmware flaw weakened wallet seeds and that about 242 customer accounts have reported losses. This post Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Global Debt Will Make Bitcoin the Best Performing Asset in the World
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Global Debt Will Make Bitcoin the Best Performing Asset in the World CJ Konstantinos — Founder & CEO, Peoples Reserve, makes the case that America's debt problem is Bitcoin's biggest tailwind. title: UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65%
content: Bitcoin Magazine UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65% UniCredit began selling a six-year, capital-protected certificate linked to BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin ETP to retail clients in Italy, with gains capped at 65%. This post UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20%
content: Bitcoin Magazine South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20% South Korea’s financial regulator unveiled a bill that would cap major shareholders of crypto exchanges at 20%, allow domestic ICOs and let bank-led groups issue won stablecoins. This post South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
